text:
marco: quick sync — finalizing Q2 catalog lifecycle items: bench slices, soft-pin behavior, migration stipend. 30m huddle?

tasha: propose we consolidate bench into three lenses: latency, quality, ops-cost. initial thresholds: p95 <=180ms (short ctx), embedding MAP >=0.86, cost-delta <= +25% vs baseline model.

devin: cost-delta is fuzzy pre-prod. prefer MAP >=0.88 if we're gating onboarding on quality. can we do cost bracket estimates and a short smoke run?

ravi: ops note — 180ms P95 is unrealistic for >8k contexts. recommend context-tiering: short (<=2048) p95 <=180ms, long (>2048) p95 <=300ms. keep quality strict.

tasha: ack on tiering. for pin TTL i'm leaning to 45d soft expiry + one auto-renew if customer explicitly opts in. enterprise: configurable up to 120d renewable via contract.

laura: product stance: do NOT auto-renew without explicit opt-in. instead: automated reminders at 30d/14d/3d; after expiry move pin to "soft-expired" (reads allowed) for 7d, then unpinned unless customer chosen longpin. :bell:

devin: migration stipend: mid-market: flat credit = 12% of forecasted month1 usage + 5 days concierge. enterprise: negotiable, default package = 10% credit + 2w concierge.

ops-bot: infra: canary capacity us-east-1 = 4 slots free. Use `/canary reserve --region=us-east-1 --count=1` to claim. :gear:

marco: rollout plan sketch: internal canary 24h -> customer canary 72h (5 customers) -> broaden 14d -> GA. telemetry delta gates: latency increase >5% OR error rate +0.3pp OR quality regression on any of 5 smoke prompts => pause rollout.

ravi: add explicit auto-rollback rule: if any tenant observes >10% perf regression vs baseline or sustained error spike >1% for 1h, automatically shift their traffic to previous pinned version and alert SRE. SLA note required.

tasha: pin granularity question: model-id vs variant pinning. ops prefers model-id pin and runtime chooses flavor (fp16/int8) with bench metadata per flavor to avoid duplicate catalog noise.

devin: agree on model-id pin + flavor hints. include manifest fields like `flavors: [fp16, int8]` and `bench: {flavor: {p95_ms, throughput, quality}}`. add visible "ops-cost-est" in catalog entry for sales.

laura: i will draft the comms timeline and PR for the spec. any objections to the plan? please call out now. :spiral_calendar:

marco: no objections, please add explicit UX copy for longpin opt-in and the reminder cadence.

devin: small YAML bench snippet for PR:

```
bench_manifest:
  context_tiers:
    short:
      p95_ms: 180
      embedding_map_min: 0.86
      cost_delta_pct: 25
    long:
      p95_ms: 300
      embedding_map_min: 0.86
      cost_delta_pct: 35
  flavors:
    - name: fp16
      bench:
        p95_ms: 180
        throughput_rps: 6
        embedding_map: 0.88
    - name: int8
      bench:
        p95_ms: 240
        throughput_rps: 9
        embedding_map: 0.86
```

laura: nice. i'll include the YAML in the PR and tag @sales-ops, @support.

marco: final call: pin TTL default 45d soft-expiry, opt-in auto-renew once, enterprise configurable to 120d renewable; bench tiering short/long; migration stipend packages as above; rollout + auto-rollback rules. i'll consolidate and push PR.

tasha: thanks — please include the comms windows (30/14/3 day nudges) and the soft-expire UX.

ravi: infra will validate canary automation and the auto-rollback hooks pre-PR. ops-bot: run smoke after deploy?

canary-bot: scheduled smoke run queued on staging — ETA 18m. :robot_face:

laura: thanks all — i'll watch for PR comments and iterate.
